en: A monochrome image showing a large European city square bordered by substantial historic buildings in eclectic/Baroque Revival style. On the left is a long multi‑storey building with steep tiled roofs and dormers; in the center‑right stands a dominant, domed civic building with many rectangular windows and arched entrances at ground level, fronting an open plaza with a few streetlamps. To the far right, the edge of an ornate tower or façade is visible, and in the far background a church spire rises above the skyline. The image appears to be an old photographic print or negative with visible dust and scratches. No printed title or writing is visible on the front.
